summary.motive: Exploit the quarterback’s conditioned fear of the Cover 0 house blitz by bluffing 7 rushers and bailing 4 into the exact hot throwing windows.
summary.whyItWorks: Quarterbacks facing Flores’ Cover 0 are coached to release the ball in under 1.5 seconds to their primary hot read; dropping 8 turns that hot throw into an interception.
summary.failureMode: QB with exceptional pocket poise who holds the ball, scrambles against the 3-man rush, and finds a late-developing scramble drill opening.

beats.title: 7-Man Blitz Illusion at Snap
beats.text: Flores presents the exact same 7-man mug look that destroyed the offense earlier. The quarterback immediately identifies Cover 0 and keys his primary hot slant.

beats.title: 4 Rushers Bail into Short Passing Lanes
beats.text: At the snap, 4 mugged linebackers bail backward into intermediate zone cushions while only 3 rushers push the pocket, instantly flooding all underneath passing lanes.

beats.title: QB Throws Hot Right into Lurker’s Chest
beats.text: Conditioned to throw in 1.5 seconds against Cover 0, the QB delivers a blind hot slant directly to where LURKER has dropped into the passing window.

beats.title: Turnover Forced: Lurk Interception
beats.text: LURKER intercepts the pass in stride with 8 defenders blanketing every receiver, converting Flores’ psychological pressure into an explosive defensive turnover.

relations.tell: Four mugged rushers bail backward at snap into intermediate zone cushions while 3 rushers push pocket.
